( Second Revision)
o.
FOREWORD

0.1 This Indian Standard (Second Revision) was adopted by the Indian Standards Institution on 31 December 1985, after the draft finalized by the Animal Feeds Sectional Committee had been approved by the Agricultural and Food Products Division Council.

0.2 In order to encourage the use of solvent-extracted oilcakes (meals)
for feeding the livestock and at the same time to ensure the extracted meals to be free from toxic hazards, it was keenly felt by the Ministry of Health that national standards be formulated to control the quality of the solvent extracted oilcakes ( meals ). 0.3 It has been observed that it is toxic to the poultry and should not be used in their ration in quantity exceeding 5 percent. 0.4 This standard was firlt published in 1966 and revised in 1968. The Committee in the present revision took note of the latest developments in the manufacturing, trading, storing and consumption pattern of the product and accordingly the requirements are being modified. Opportunity is also being taken to align the references to the test methods for various requirements given in IS : 7874 ( Part 1 )-1975*.

0.5 Inclusion of the aflatoxin limit in the standard did not find favour
with the Committee at this stage because of the non-availability of a reliable and quick method for its determination. Further, data for fixing a safe limit in the product meant for livestock feed was also not available. However, it was a considered view of the Committee for fixing this limit as early as possible.
4. �

� Methods of tests (or animal feeds and (eeding stuff.: Part I General method�.

3

IS : 3592 � 1985
0.6 In the preparation of this standard due consideration has been given to the provision of the solvent extraction orders. However, this standard is subject to the restrictions imposed under these, wherever applicable. 0.7 For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of this standard is complied with, the final value, observed or calculated, expressing the result of a test or analysis, shall be rounded off in accordance with IS : 2-1960*. The number of significant places retained in the rounded off value should be the same as that of the specified value in this standard.

1. SCOPE
1.1 This standard prescribes the requirements and methods of sampling and test for solvent-extracted decorticated cottonseed oilcake ( meal ) for use as livestock feed ingredient.

2. REQUIREMENTS
2.1 The material shall be in the form of either flakes or powder and shall be free from other harmful constituents. It shall be free from rancidity, adulterants, insects or visible fungus infestations and from musty odour. The material shall be free from harmful constituents. It shall be free from other extraneous matter including metallic pieces, 2.2 SolveDt for EstraetloD - Only hexane of food grade conforming to IS: 3470-1966t shall be used for extracting decorticated cottonseed oilcake. 2.3 The material shall also conform to the requirements prescribed in Table 1.

3. PACKING AND MARKING
3.1 PaeklDI - Unless otherwise agreed to between the purchaser and
the vendor the material shall be packed in clean and sound jute bags or HDPE bags. The mouth of each bag shall be either machine-stitched or rolled over and hand-stitched. If hand-stitched, the stitching shall be with strong twine with at least 14 stitches in each row. ,-Rules Cor rounding off numerical values ( ,msld ). fSpecification for hexane, food grade.

3.2 MarkiDI - Each bag shall give indelibly and legibly the following information: a) Name and grade of the material; b) Name of the manufacturer; c) Batch or code number; d) Net mass in kg, when packed; and e) Date of packing.

4. SAMPLING
4.1 The method of drawing representative samples of the material for tests and the criteria for conformity shall be as prescribed in Appendix C of IS : 2052-1979*.
